title: Minecraft EASY Wood Farm Tutorial 1.21 - All Types - NEW!
description:
Hello Guys TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Efficient Wood [ Tree ] Farm In Minecraft 1.21

❌Important !! : Your inventory slots should be completely full, for this put stackable items on each slot of your inventory
❌Important !! : Unfortunately, this farm doesn't work on Paper Servers Due to bug fixes, Paper servers may need to set ( "allow-piston-duplication" ) to true to enable TNT duping in the configuration file ( "yml" )
❌Important !! : Don't skip the TNT & Important details of the farm chapters ( Very important )

📚This Wood Farm is so easy to build and you can build this farm in 20 - 40mins!
📚You can use all types of woods on this farm ( also you can use brown and red mushrooms ! )
📚Unfortunately because of tnt duper, this farm doesn't work on the bedrock edition
📚You can build this farm anywhere you want
📚Be sure to watch the Important Details chapter in its entirety because you will need to change something in the farm for each type of wood! ( setup of the farm is so important! )
📚Farm rate with bone meal rate is presented below this section:

🔴 The First Rate ( 📈Prodcation Rate P/H ) and Second Rate ( 📈Bonemeals Usage P/H ) :
🟡 Birch 📈9660 Per Hour  ( 📈10160 Bone meal Per Hour )
🟡 Oak [ From azalea ] 📈9520 Per Hour  ( 📈4120 Bone meal Per Hour ) [ Recommended Option for oak wood logs ]
🟡 Acacia 📈8520 Per Hour  ( 📈6220 Bone meal Per Hour )
🟡 Oak [ From Saplings ] 📈7510 Per Hour   ( 📈8610 Bone meal Per Hour )
🟡 Spruce 📈7430 Per Hour  ( 8510 Bone meal Per Hour )
🟡 Jungle 📈7110 Per Hour  ( 📈5050 Bone meal Per Hour )
🟡 Cherry Blossom ⁓📈13100 Per Hour  [ Based on snapshot ]
🟡 Crimson 📈7050 Per Hour  ( 📈4400 Bone meal Per Hour, 📈960 Fungi Per Hour  )
🟡 Warped 📈7220 Per Hour  ( 📈4100 Bone meal Per Hour, 📈995 Fungi Per Hour  )
🟡 Red Mushroom 📈24100 Per Hour  ( 📈7120 Bone meal Per Hour )
🟡 Brown Mushroom 📈5100 Per Hour  ( 📈1420 Bone meal Per Hour )
